artifact-signing-premium-low-volume.title: Basic tier is cheaper at this signing volume
artifact-signing-premium-low-volume.body: This estimate uses the Premium tier, but Basic keeps signing after its 5,000 included signatures at the same per-signature price as Premium, so Basic costs less at this volume. Premium only pays off at high volume (about 23,000 signatures a month per account) or when you need more than one signing certificate of the same kind. Compare a Basic option.

citation.source: Change an Artifact Signing account SKU (pricing tier)
citation.quote: You can change the SKU for an Artifact Signing account at any time by upgrading to Premium or by downgrading to Basic.

artifact-signing-basic-high-volume.title: Premium tier is cheaper at this signing volume
artifact-signing-basic-high-volume.body: This estimate uses the Basic tier, but at this volume the overage of $0.005 per signature beyond its 5,000 included signatures costs more than the Premium account fee, which includes 100,000 signatures a month. Premium (with up to 10 certificates of each kind) is cheaper above about 23,000 signatures a month per account. Compare a Premium option.

citation.source: Change an Artifact Signing account SKU (pricing tier)
